notes:
POC objectives: reduce agent triage time by 30-45%; auto-tag >= 85% of incoming tickets with confidence scores; generate 1-2 line agent-ready summary + suggested macro/tool action.

Key constraints / asks: vpc + SSO/SAML + per-tenant KMS; must support Zendesk triggers and Freshdesk webhooks; need webhook retries and idempotency guarantees for spikes. They asked: 'Can the model respect org-specific taxonomy for tags?' — want training + deterministic mapping layer.

On reliability: heavy concern around Black Friday–like spikes from partners (historical peak: 6x baseline). They require failover to a cheaper fallback model and a circuit-breaker policy. Pricing discussion: Emberline expects a clear cost-per-ticket estimate with rate-limited burst cap.

POC success metrics (from call):
- Summary quality: >4/5 on agent rating (sample set)
- Tagging precision: >0.85 at confidence >= 0.6
- End-to-end latency: median < 350ms for single-ticket extract+tag at 95th pct under baseline load

Integrations & artifacts: pricing deck + POC scope in Drive; security FAQ in Drive (see linked_drive_docs). Raised a Jira for infra limits: AIINFRA-142 (request for dedicated burst pool).

Next steps: infra scoping call 2026-03-12 (Priya/Jordan + Emberline infra). Need to deliver sample ingestion script and prebuilt Zendesk macros before call. Customer wants a one-page runbook for fallback behavior during spikes.
